title: docs(skills, spec): every published package declares one anchor-safe isDefault permission set
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFfzvMqgJHhisBXrtmgA5T9)_
Fixes #25773

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Summary

Consequence (ii) of maintainer ruling record 6341690661: the published skill and the marketplace reference now state that every published package declares exactly one anchor-safe `isDefault: true` permission set. Text only. No lint rule, schema key or runtime path changes, and no new gate (the ruling orders the text; a gate needs the maintainer's own word).

## What changed

1. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, the `isDefault: true` bullet under the RBAC section. It keeps the semantics (the `everyone` baseline, ADR-0090 D5) and adds the requirement as a check an author can run: exactly one such set, anchor-safe, meaning `describeAnchorForbiddenBits(set, 'everyone')` from `@objectstack/spec/security` returns `null`. It names the two refusals that already exist (lint rule `security-anchor-high-privilege`, and the binding), says what happens with none (invited members get nothing until an admin assigns a set to each), and says that no gate counts the sets. The old "lint and boot refuse a platform capability or undeclared name" clause is folded in: it is exactly what the anchor-safe predicate refuses in `systemPermissions`, so the bullet now says the set's `systemPermissions` may name only app capabilities declared under `capabilities:`.
2. Marketplace docs. The source is the Marketplace Protocol module doc block at the top of `packages/spec/src/marketplace/marketplace.zod.ts`, which `build-docs.ts` renders as `content/docs/references/marketplace/marketplace.mdx` (AUTO-GEN, not hand-edited). That block already carries the "Developer Publishing Flow" a publisher reads, so the new section sits right after it. The exact source sentence added: "Exactly one anchor-safe default permission set (ADR-0090 D5): `isDefault: true`, and `describeAnchorForbiddenBits(set, 'everyone')` from `@objectstack/spec/security` returns `null`." The section then gives the reason and the enforcement facts. Regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:docs`; the only regenerated diff is the new 9-line "What a published package declares" section in `marketplace.mdx` (commit f1340f32).
3. `.changeset/25773-published-package-default-permission-set.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/skills` (ships `skills/**`) and `@objectstack/spec` (ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so the edited doc block is published text).

## Where the predicate and the refusals live (read at `cb0a2fcf`)

- Predicate: `describeAnchorForbiddenBits` in `packages/spec/src/security/high-privilege.ts`, exported from `@objectstack/spec/security`. For `everyone` it is `describeHighPrivilegeBits` with the stack's declared capabilities as context: no platform or undeclared `systemPermissions`, no `viewAllRecords` / `modifyAllRecords`, no `allowDelete` / `allowTransfer` / `allowExport` on any object.
- Author-time refusal: `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`, rule `SECURITY_ANCHOR_HIGH_PRIVILEGE` = `security-anchor-high-privilege` (error), run on every `isDefault: true` set.
- Bind-time refusal: `confirmAudienceBindingSuggestion` in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/suggested-audience-bindings.ts` runs the same predicate; at boot `everyoneBaseline` in `security-plugin.ts` withholds a high-privilege set from `everyone`.
- Presence and count: nothing enforces them. `appDefaultPermissionSetName` (`plugin-security/src/app-default-permission-set.ts`) takes the first `isDefault` set and returns `undefined` when there is none, with no diagnostic. The text says "no gate counts them" for that reason.

## Token ratchet (`skills/**`)

| Reading | Before (`cb0a2fcf`) | After (`f1340f32`) |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `rules/security.md` tokens (ceiling 2563, not raised) | 2563 | 2561 |
| `rules/security.md` lines | 220 | 220 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/**` lines | 3806 | 3806 |
| all `skills/*/SKILL.md` lines (untouched) | 4383 | 4383 |
| bundle total tokens (`check-skills-token-ratchet`; before = after + 2, only this file moved) | 155469 | 155467 |

The new text (+66 tokens on the bullet as first drafted) is paid by deleting content in the same file, with no re-wrap counted as savings: the `stack.zod.ts` path aside on the `permissionSets:` bullet; the parenthetical after the `rls.zod.ts` source line; the parenthetical after the `field.zod.ts` source line; ADR-0105 §"Today's two postures" from the multi-tenancy reference (ADR-0093 and the tenancy-modes URL stay); "plugin-security's FieldMasker enforces it. The real channels are:" shortened to "(FieldMasker). Two more channels:"; and the capability clause folded into the anchor-safe sentence as described above.

## Gates (head `f1340f32`)

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 113 commands. All 113 run with exit codes captured before any pipe: 113 exit 0. Six first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`) and answered exit 0 after a full `pnpm turbo run build` under the verify lock. `dispatch-gates --ran`: "113 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Also `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` exit 0, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0, `check:generated` exit 0 after `gen:docs`. No tests changed and no tested behaviour changed, so there is no ablation. CI families (Test Core, Build Core, Build Docs, type-check lanes) are left to this PR's check-runs.

## 维护者速读（草稿）

- **改了什么**：对外发布的技能文档 `security.md` 和 marketplace 参考文档里，写明"每个发布包必须声明且只声明一个锚安全的默认权限集（`isDefault: true`）"，并给出作者可自查的判据（`describeAnchorForbiddenBits(set, 'everyone')` 返回 `null`）。只改文字，不加门禁、不改代码行为。
- **为什么改**：落实裁决 6341690661 的第 (ii) 项：默认访问只通过一个机制到达组织邀请的成员；包里没有这样的权限集，新成员就什么都看不到，直到管理员逐人分配。原文只讲了含义，没讲要求。
- **风险与代价（含回滚）**：技能文件 token 不增（2563 → 2561），用删掉同文件三处源码路径旁注、一处 ADR 章节引用和一句话来抵账。回滚即还原这两个文件并重生成文档页。
- **席位意见**：
- **你要做的**：这是 Tier H（`skills/**`），需要你批准后由席位落地。

## Acceptance notes

- No gate refuses a package that declares no `isDefault` set or more than one; the app-level reader `appDefaultPermissionSetName` silently takes the first. Whether a gate should enforce this at publish time is left for the maintainer's word, per the card's boundary.
